structure.jp: ポケモンに　それは　やさしく　けづくろいを　して　あげていた
structure.en: who was grooming the Pokémon ever so gently

structure.jp: あの　しょうじょは…
たしか　ナナミと　いったか…
structure.en: she was called Daisy, I think…

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: けづくろいを　して　あげていた　あの　しょうじょ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb sits in front of a person or thing and tells you which one. けづくろいを して あげていた あの しょうじょ = 'that girl who was grooming them'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says the action is done as a kindness for someone. して あげていた = 'was doing it for them'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before いう shows what something is called. ナナミと いった = 'was called Daisy'.
